cover: Hospital strike kills six; baby dies of cold
Wangchuk says he is under house arrest

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: A strike on a hospital
bullets: Medics say a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy were among the dead.
Israel's military says it targeted a Hamas commander.
A nine-month-old died of hypothermia in a tent.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Three months of killings
bullets: Gangs caused over 45% of incidents, a UN report says.
Over half the killings came in security operations against gangs.

stories.label: India · Assembly
stories.head: Kept at home before a protest
bullets: Sonam Wangchuk opposes holding council polls on 4 December.
He says no written order was served on him.
Police say he was advised to stay home under election orders.

stories.label: World · Livelihood
stories.head: Less food as funds run dry
bullets: WFP reached over 4 million people in August.
Just over 3 million now, after funding cuts.
